basic_info.description: Huge price reduction! Located in Bernal Heights' most sought-after area, this 3-bedroom, 2-bath home offers an exceptional opportunity just steps from the vibrant shops and restaurants along Cortland Avenue. Set in the heart of the neighborhood, this family home is ready for its next chapter. A true fixer-upper, it's ideal for a contractor, investor, or first-time homebuyer with vision and creativity. With the right imagination, you can transform this property into your dream home in one of San Francisco's most beloved communities.    The property also features a garden with mature fruit trees, offering a private outdoor retreat with space to enjoy and grow. Bay views!
